notes: Uses the existing PI30 VMII profile; no new commands, transport or wider write ranges are introduced.

The owner confirmed Output Source Priority, Charge Source Priority and battery bulk, float, cut-off and recharge voltage controls on integration 0.1.53. Other controls and firmware variants are not confirmed by this report.

known_limitations: QMN reports the shared VMII-NXPW5KW identity, not a unique Victor retail model. Automatic detection therefore displays PI30 VMII-NXPW5KW; the public catalog records the owner-reported brand separately.
QVFW3 and optional QET/QLT/QT energy commands returned NAK in the supplied archive.
Hardware confirmation was supplied for integration 0.1.53; replay on current code does not replace a current-version hardware test.
knowledge_summary: Victor NM-PRO-6.2KW is confirmed by the issue #54 owner and support archive as a 6200 W / 48 V PI30 inverter using the shared VMII-NXPW5KW profile, with working telemetry and a specifically reported subset of controls.
